title: Reset your password - Oxen
subject: Your Oxen password reset code
instruction: Use this code to reset the password of your Oxen account:
validity_notice: This code is valid for 10 minutes.
security_notice: Never share this code. Oxen will never ask you for it by phone, email or message. If you did not ask to reset your password, ignore this email: your password stays unchanged. If you receive several of these emails without asking, contact us.
